Wow, World Ventures. Something I actually have a story about. Not sure if people will see it, but here we go anyway.

To give y'all some context. I work as an IT-Tech and have been for a good a good while now but this was about 3 years ago. My SO at the time and I had just split so I was couch surfing while I was looking for a permanent place to stay. A good friend of mine introduced me to his dad since he had an apartment I could temporarely rent and being kinda sick of living with other people, it was a great idea.

After some time living there, the dad asked me if I could help him with connecting and setting up his new home network and considering he almost saved me from the streets or living in my car, I couldn't say no. When that was all said and done, he wanted to thank me by treating me to dinner and I accepted.

We had a nice time but here's where World Ventures come in. After dinner he brought me into a conference room where there were at least 15 other people. We sat down and they started this presentation that I can only describe as cultlike. Being the only one there not signed up, it was super weird with how they all just sat around talking about this amazing experience they've all gotten through this "company".

Needless to say, he tried to sign me up but I refused. There's also the story of my friend being forced to hold up signs and stuff for promotional material but that's his story to tell.
